moves.name: Neck release
how: Sit tall, shoulders heavy.
Tip your right ear towards your right shoulder and take 3 slow breaths.
Switch sides.

moves.name: Doorway chest opener
how: Forearms on the door frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through until you feel the chest open.
Breathe slowly; don’t push into pain.

moves.name: Standing forward fold
moves.cue: Stand up from your chair first.
how: Feet hip-width, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips and let your head and arms hang.
Roll up slowly, one vertebra at a time.

moves.name: Kneeling hip-flexor stretch
how: Kneel on one knee, other foot in front.
Tuck your tailbone and shift forward gently.
Half the time each side.

moves.name: Wrist & forearm stretch
how: Arm straight, palm up; gently pull fingers back with the other hand.
Then palm down, fingers towards you.
Both arms.

moves.name: Seated spinal twist
how: Sit tall, feet flat.
Turn your chest to the right, hand on the chair back; breathe.
Switch sides.

moves.name: Calf stretch on a wall
how: Hands on the wall, one foot back, heel down.
Lean in until the back calf stretches.
Switch legs halfway.

moves.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
how: Bring one arm across your chest.
Hug it in with the other forearm.
Switch halfway.

moves.name: Bodyweight squats
how: Feet shoulder-width, arms forward.
Sit back as if into a chair, chest up.
Stand up through your heels.

moves.name: Desk push-ups
moves.cue: Hands on a sturdy desk or counter.
how: Hands on the edge, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge.
Press back up.

moves.name: Wall sit
how: Slide down until knees are near 90°.
Knees over ankles, back flat on the wall.
Breathe and hold.

moves.name: Calf raises
how: Stand tall, hold something for balance if needed.
Rise onto your toes, pause.
Lower slowly.

moves.name: Reverse lunges
moves.cue: A few steps of space is enough.
how: Step one foot back and lower the back knee.
Front knee stays over the ankle.
Push back up; alternate legs.

moves.name: Glute bridges
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips.
Lower slowly.

moves.name: Plank
moves.cue: On forearms; knees down is fine.
how: Elbows under shoulders.
Body in one line, belly braced.
Breathe, don’t hold your breath.

moves.name: Chair dips
moves.cue: Only on a chair that won’t roll.
how: Hands on the seat edge, feet forward.
Bend elbows to lower your hips.
Press back up.

moves.name: Superman hold
how: Arms overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a little.
Hold, then relax.

moves.name: Take the stairs
how: Walk up at a brisk pace.
Use the rail.
Walk down slowly.

moves.name: High-knee march
how: Lift knees towards hip height.
Swing your arms.
Go faster if it feels good.

moves.name: Jumping jacks
moves.cue: Step-jacks if you’d rather not jump.
how: Jump feet out as arms go up.
Jump back in.
Low-impact: step one foot out at a time.

moves.name: Walk your next call
moves.cue: Phone call or voice note? Walk it.
how: Stand up before you dial.
Walk at a brisk pace while you talk.
Tick it off after the call.

moves.name: Shadow boxing
how: Guard up, soft knees.
Jab, cross, hook; keep moving.
Breathe out on each punch.

moves.name: Skater steps
how: Step wide to the right, sweep the left leg behind.
Switch sides in a rhythm.
Hop it when you feel ready.

moves.name: Two-minute brisk walk
moves.cue: Around the room, the corridor or the garden.
how: Walk faster than usual.
Swing your arms.
Notice your breath rising.

moves.name: Half sun salutation
moves.cue: Great first thing, or after a long sit.
how: Inhale arms up.
Exhale fold forward; inhale halfway lift.
Exhale fold; inhale rise up. That’s one round.

moves.name: Cat–cow
moves.cue: On hands and knees, or seated.
how: Inhale: drop the belly, lift the gaze.
Exhale: round the back, tuck the chin.
Move with each breath.

moves.name: Downward dog
how: From hands and knees, lift the hips up and back.
Bend the knees as much as you need.
Press the floor away.

moves.name: Tree pose
moves.cue: Half the time on each leg.
how: Stand on one leg; foot on the calf or thigh (not the knee).
Hands at the chest, eyes on one still point.
Switch legs.

moves.name: Warrior II
how: Wide stance, front knee bent over the ankle.
Arms out, gaze over the front hand.
Switch sides.

moves.name: Child’s pose
how: Kneel, sit back on your heels.
Fold forward, arms long or by your sides.
Breathe into your back.

moves.name: Mountain pose + 5 breaths
how: Feet grounded, spine long, crown up.
Soften the shoulders.
Five slow breaths, eyes open or closed.

moves.name: Chair pose
how: Feet together, bend the knees.
Arms up by the ears.
Weight in the heels; breathe.
